# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 13 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches & Private Residential

- **Bukit Sembawang launches Phase 10 of Luxus Hills in Seletar Hills** - The new phase features five-bedroom Type A and Type B terrace houses on 999-year tenure, with private lifts, rooftop solar panels and EV-ready provisions. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/toured-a-new-collection-of-999-year-landed-homes-seletar/)

- **Debate over agents getting priority access at new condo launches** - A piece published 9 Aug 2026 questions whether agents receiving first-dibs at new launches is fair, referencing prevailing price points of around $2,700 psf, and examines whether a more equitable system is possible. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/should-property-agents-get-first-dibs-at-new-condo-launches-there-may-be-a-fairer-way/)

## Rental Yields & Investment Purchases

- **East Coast condo rental yield rankings: sea-facing units lead, freehold tenure on larger units does not** - An analysis ranking East Coast condos by rental yield found that sea-facing units recover their price premium through rent, while freehold status on larger units did not translate to stronger yields. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/we-ranked-east-coast-condos-by-rental-yield-one-40-year-old-project-kept-coming-out-on-top/)

- **Couple secures Riverfront Residences unit at $1.69M after five-way bidding war** - The buyers chose a three-bedroom unit in Hougang over Treasure at Tampines following an on-site viewing, and completed the purchase amid competitive bidding. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/why-we-bought-a-1-69m-condo-without-a-nearby-mrt-as-an-investment/)

## Property & Divorce: Stamp Duty and CPF Implications

- **Divorcing couples in Singapore face SSD, CPF refunds and refinancing before any court order is settled** - A breakdown across three common ownership scenarios shows the financial steps involved when a matrimonial home is split, including Seller's Stamp Duty obligations and CPF repayment requirements. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/what-happens-to-your-property-when-you-get-divorced-in-singapore/)
